newsitem.title: USA: Gaming World delisted from Nasdaq Smallcap.
newsitem.headline: Gaming World delisted from Nasdaq Smallcap.

text.p: Gaming World International Ltd said on Tuesday that it has been informed by the Nasdaq Stock Market that effective December 26, 1996, the company's securities will no longer be traded on the Nasdaq/SmallCap Market.
Gaming World said its stock will be moved to the OTC Bulletin Board System.
The company said the reason for the move is its inability to meet the Nasdaq/SmallCap continued listing requirement of a bid price of at least $1.00 per share.
